newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - August 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - August 6.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Ten more occupations to be included under protection of Labour Law by end-August.
Five central American allies refuse to sign agreement on free trade zone with Taiwan.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taipei proposes to "share sovereignty" with Beijing; cross-strait talks expected to resume in March.
Korean Air Lines jet crashes in Guam, 29 of 331 passengers survive.
LIBERTY TIMES - New cabinet led by lawmaker Vincent Siew surfaces; Foreign Minister John Chang to become vice premier.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Vice Premier Hsu Li-teh expected to head ruling Nationalist Party's planned Global Commercial Bank.
U.S. dollar surges against Japanese yen and German mark.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co to accelerate 10-year T$400 billion project.
Taiwan firms can't set up investment companies in mainland China, Economics Ministry says.
